qaNotes: Openbox Alt-wheel changed virtual desktops before the event reached GPUI. Removed Alt-wheel bindings only from the private Xvfb WM config and repeated the check. Production desktop settings untouched.
The history-wheel check first remained in the alternate screen, which correctly sent app-cursor arrows. The fixture was corrected to leave alternate screen before the scrollback check.
Initial and recovered static frames are identical. Error screenshots deliberately show an inline error and shifted terminal grid.
No actual Pi/Grok/model run was performed; these are deterministic terminal protocol fixtures.
limitations: Full terminal fidelity and original Electron UI pixel parity remain NOT_PASSED.

The existing host Input path converts bytes to UTF-8. Classic high-bit mouse reports cannot be delivered exactly; GPUI shows an explicit error and sends no corrupt replacement bytes. SGR and SGR-pixel modes and ASCII classic reports work through the existing path. A future raw-byte capability needs end-to-end host/worker support.

The shared worker replay-mode tracker drops ESC split before [, conditionally resets mouse modes differently from xterm, and does not observe RIS. Native live observation handles these traces; cold replay of those shared-host edge cases remains unresolved. The cold GUI fixture uses complete mode sequences.

Horizontal wheel, Mac/Windows GUI pointer behavior, word/line selection gestures, drag autoscroll, primary clipboard/context menus, complete IME/keyboard, reconnect and real provider workloads still require validation.
Hard-line trailing-space copy mismatch from the selection checkpoint remains.
No complete performance, memory or multi-platform deployment acceptance.
cleanup: Confirmed fixture, its PTYs and client stopped; stopped only matching private Xvfb/Openbox PIDs and removed the private fixture home. Production daemon and user sessions untouched.
